implicit_compile_requirements.reason: The pinned files use these unqualified without a direct provider import, or require them through property-wrapper/result-builder lowering. SwiftUI may re-export the single authoritative provider module rather than redeclare its types.
implicit_compile_requirements.visibility_derivation: For each exact importer, scan a reviewed external-symbol vocabulary and retain occurrences when the source does not directly import the provider (UIKit is an accepted direct visibility route for Foundation/CoreGraphics/CoreText). Locations prove unqualified visibility demand, not declaration ownership.
